settings.title: Logging settings
settings.description: Runtime logging controls backed by app settings.

backups.description: Every backup includes the full database and all media originals in one portable file.

deleteDialog.title: Delete snapshot

importDialog.title: Import backup

settingsDialog.description: Configure retention and restore safety behaviour.
settingsDialog.maxBackupsHint: Older ready full backups are pruned after creation unless legacy history or active downloads protect them. Set 0 to disable pruning. The independent 128-record history budget still applies.
